subject: pkg/dxf/importinto: adapt meter collection for conflict handling (#66737)
summary: Threads DXF metering recorder into conflict collection/resolution (Collector/Deleter) via a local TrafficRecorder interface, records best-effort TiKV BatchGet/delete byte traffic, and avoids rewriting external subtask meta when no conflicts to reduce unnecessary object-store PUTs; updates/extends realtikv metering assertions accordingly.
